description: Written & self-produced at his home studio, the 'Inside World' EP is a kaleidoscopic introduction to a brave new musical force. Lifting effortlessly from diverse musical worlds - 70's psychedelic soul, sun-kissed folk-rock & jazz fusion to name just a few - Alex's songwriting sits gently in its warm cloak of production as he confides stories from the fringes of London life.
credits:
All songs written & produced by Alex Burey.
1 & 4 mixed by Neil Comber / 2 & 3 mixed by Al Stone.
